copy.intro: You've had a Polène Numéro Un in your basket for a week and you still haven't clicked buy. Maybe it's the price, or the taxes added on top of US delivery. Either way, you want to see what else is out there. These brands make leather and vegan-leather bags at prices around, below and well above Polène's, sorted with the closest on price first.

bodies.demellier:
DeMellier is the closest match on price and on how the bags are made. They're designed in London, handcrafted in Spain and priced from £365 to £665 (about $485 to $884). The Midi New York (£475, about $631) sits right in the middle of that range, so it's the fair one to hold up against a Numéro Un ($580).

The real difference shows up at checkout. DeMellier ships to the US free with duties already in the price, while Polène adds taxes on US delivery. Returns are free too, within 28 days. If you like Polène's tiny Nano bags, The Nano Montreal (£365, about $485) is the size to look at.

The catch is the currency. Prices are in pounds, so the dollar figure moves with the exchange rate. If you'd rather pay in dollars, Strathberry is next.
bodies.strathberry:
Strathberry is the pick if what you love about Polène is where it's made. It designs in Edinburgh and has its bags handcrafted in Ubrique, Spain, the same leather-working town Polène uses. The Mosaic Nano ($635) costs about what a Polène Numéro Neuf ($610) does.

Its US store charges in dollars, from $495 for the Kite on a Chain to $995 for the Tote, so most of the range overlaps Polène's. US orders ship free with duties paid up front, and returns are free for 30 days, two days longer than DeMellier's.

One thing to know before you fall for a shape. The designs are built around a signature Music Bar clasp, so the hardware does more of the talking than it does on Polène's sculpted Cyme.
bodies.songmont:
Songmont is where to go for Polène's minimal, leather-led look at a lower price. Its middle-of-the-range bag costs $429, against Polène's $610. Start with the Song Bag, which comes in four sizes from the Mini ($269) to the Large ($519), so you can match whichever Polène size you had in mind.

It's a Chinese leather-goods brand built on Eastern minimalist design, so expect plain, pared-back shapes rather than Polène's folds and curves. Shipping to the US is free over $100. And for US returns within 30 days, it pays the postage both ways, even when you've simply changed your mind.

If you want to spend less again and don't need leather, JW PEI starts well under $100.
bodies.jw-pei:
JW PEI is the one for a vegan-leather everyday bag well under $200. Its typical bag costs $139, and the Joy Shoulder Bag is $99.

It's a Los Angeles label founded in 2018, and vegan leather and faux suede make up most of what it sells. That's the big difference from Polène's Italian calf leather. The woven styles are worth a look if you want texture without a big spend: the Lucia Classic Top Handle Woven Bag is $139.

Two things to weigh. Free US shipping starts at $200, and you pay for return postage within the 30-day window. If you want suede rather than faux suede at a similar price, Quince's Hudson Suede Tote ($174) is the swap.
bodies.charles-keith:
Charles & Keith is the high-street way to try the look, with bags from $49 to $229 in its US store. Its leather line is the part to look at: the Gabine Leather Burnished Shoulder Bag tops the range at $229.

It's a Singapore label founded in 1996 that sells shoes and accessories as well as bags. The Calla Tote Bag ($139) costs about a quarter of a Polène Numéro Un ($580), which makes it an easy way to find out which shape you'd actually carry. Shipping is free over $125, and returns are accepted within 30 days, though the prepaid UPS label ($8.50) comes out of your refund.

If a long return window matters more to you than the label, Quince gives you a full year.
bodies.quince:
Quince is the cheapest pick here for suede and handwoven bags, with everything topping out at $198. The Sloane Handwoven Mini Shoulder Bag costs $120.

Its model is factory-direct, which is how the prices stay this low. Shipping is always free, and you get 365 days to return most things, which makes trying one far less risky than anything else on this list.

The Hudson Suede Tote ($174) is the one to compare with Polène's Cyme ($620) if you mainly want an everyday tote. It won't have the Cyme's sculpted folds, but it costs less than a third as much. And if you'd rather stay with leather, Songmont is where to look next.
bodies.loewe:
Loewe is the pick if you've decided to spend more than Polène charges. Its bags begin at $650 for the Small Basket bag in palm leaf and calfskin, and the Mini Scarf bag in smooth calfskin costs $2,400.

It's a Spanish house, and its US store ships for free. The thing to watch is the return window. You get 14 days from delivery, the shortest on this list, so this isn't the place to order three and decide later.

That Basket bag is the only part of the range that sits near Polène's prices. If you want to stay under $1,000, Strathberry and DeMellier both do, and both have their bags handcrafted in Spain.

closing.heading: How to choose
closing.body:
Start with what's stopping you at Polène. If it's the taxes on US delivery, DeMellier and Strathberry both ship free with duties included, and both have their bags made in Spain. Strathberry charges in dollars and DeMellier in pounds. If it's the price, Songmont keeps the leather and the minimal shapes for a few hundred less.

Under $250, pick by material and by how sure you are. JW PEI is for vegan leather, Charles & Keith for a leather shoulder bag at $229, and Quince for when a 365-day return window matters more than the name. And if you've outgrown Polène altogether, Loewe is the step up, with only 14 days to change your mind.

faqs.a: Paris. Polène is a Parisian leather-goods house founded in 2016, and its US online store is run from New York.
In Spain. Polène's bags are made by leather-working artisans in Ubrique, an Andalusian village with a long history of tanning and leather work, and designed in Paris.
In the US store, bags run from $220 for the Numéro Un Micro to $1,190 for the Button Bow Box. The middle of the range is about $610, and the Cyme starts at $480 for the Mini.

faqs.q: Where can you buy Polène in the USA?
faqs.a: Online through Polène's US store, or in person at its boutiques in New York and Costa Mesa, California.
